name: branding-agritech-green-yellow-identity-grid
title: Green and yellow farm identity in a modular grid of applications
whatItIs: A brand board where tiles show a monogram 'NY' with wordmark on dark crops, business cards on lime, a colour chart, an app on a phone in a hand, a smiling farmer with a vegetable crate, a tote bag, a billboard and a construction-grid diagram of the mark.
whatItMeans: Fresh, wholesome and trustworthy; the green-yellow palette feels like leaves and sunshine.
techniques: Build a modular grid of tiles with different applications.
Use aerial crop rows as a texture for the logo tile.
Include a construction diagram to show the logo geometry.
Pair a large lifestyle photo with brand colour bands.

vocabulary.definition: A layout of tiles showing many brand applications.
A drawing showing circles and lines used to build a logo.
A top-down photo used as pattern.
